desc:
Eat food to get bigger than everyone else! The bigger you are, the more damage you do and the more health you have!
Doubletap your jump button to Double Jump and find islands to unlock more food, pets, dances and more!
LATEST UPDATE:
- NEW ISLAND 'Mushroom Oasis'
- NEW 30 MORE PETS
- NEW 30 MORE DANCES
- NEW Pet Evolution Tier 'Omega'
Follow the game to be notified of new updates!

Join Blox Universe to unlock new items in upcoming updates! https://www.roblox.com/groups/4914205/Bl-x-Universe#!/about
